lines.text: Many learners say: She is more taller than me.
Better: She is taller than me.
Taller! My brother is taller than me.

data.wrong: She is more taller than me.

native.tip: taller에는 이미 비교의 뜻이 있어요. “She is taller than me”예요.
native.caption: “She is more taller than me”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 짧은 형용사는 -er만 붙이고 more는 함께 쓰지 않아요. “She is taller than me”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Taller already shows comparison. No more. Say “She is taller than me”.
en.caption: Do you say “She is more taller than me”? 😅 Short adjectives take -er, so you do not add “more”. “She is taller than me” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
